summary_en: ¥820M authorization, 4.1M share upper limit (13.6% S/O), Jan 30–Dec 11, 2026. As of June 1, 2026: 2.618M shares acquired, ¥591.3M spent (72.1% of budget, 63.9% of share limit). May 2026 block: 1.276M shares, ¥275.3M. Open-market method (ToSTNeT).
title_en: Notice of Progress on Share Repurchase Program
translation_en_brief:
MBK Co., Ltd. filed a progress update on its share repurchase program as of May 31, 2026. The program was authorized by board resolutions on December 12, 2025 and reaffirmed on May 18, 2026. The company is permitted to acquire up to 4.1 million common shares (13.6% of issued shares excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥820 million during the window January 30–December 11, 2026, using open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

As of June 1, 2026, cumulative acquisitions stand at 2.618 million shares for ¥591.3 million, representing 63.9% of the authorized share count and 72.1% of the yen budget. In May 2026 alone, the company acquired 1.276 million shares for ¥275.3 million. Treasury holdings as of June 1 are 2.697706 million shares out of 32.806190 million issued.
